item.title: Multi-state police chase ends with damaged cruisers, injured officer, one arrest
item.description: A multi-state police chase ended with multiple damaged cruisers and one arrest Saturday after a suspect fled through Ohio and Indiana before finally being taken into custody.

item.title: CPD: 9 people in 'stable condition' after mass shooting during event at music venue in East End
item.description: Nine people were shot early Sunday morning at an event at an East End music venue, Cincinnati police said. All victims have non-life-threatening injuries, CPD said.

item.title: CFD: College Hill house fire leaves one displaced, cause under investigation
item.description: A house fire in College Hill displaced one resident Sunday evening after crews discovered heavy smoke and upgraded to a full one-alarm response.
